cases.premise: The metric export requires an in-memory privacy preview before the file is created.
cases.hypothesis: A privacy preview must occur before creating the metric export.

cases.premise: Missing token usage remains a typed unknown value.
cases.hypothesis: Missing token usage is stored as zero.

cases.premise: The review confirmed that project cursor pagination preserves the selected session.
cases.hypothesis: The review measured cursor-pagination latency under sustained load.

cases.premise: The holdout is separated by project and by observation time.
cases.hypothesis: Projects and time periods do not overlap between training and holdout cases.

cases.premise: Remote model analysis waits for a fresh one-shot approval.
cases.hypothesis: The background grant approves remote model analysis without user review.

cases.premise: The corrected parser accepts an explicit UTC offset in the event timestamp.
cases.hypothesis: The corrected parser also clears expired preview records.

cases.premise: The review requires every known metric value to cite an opaque evidence reference.
cases.hypothesis: A known metric value without an evidence reference fails review.

cases.premise: Model consensus is exploratory evidence and never supplies the gold label.
cases.hypothesis: Agreement between two models is accepted as ground truth.

cases.hypothesis: The radar chart uses five bounded axes.

cases.premise: Revision one allowed a missing denominator to default to one.
cases.hypothesis: Revision two rejects an observation with a missing denominator.

cases.premise: A synthetic note says that a reliability check was planned.
cases.hypothesis: The reliability check passed on the untouched holdout.

cases.hypothesis: Podgląd prywatności musi nastąpić przed utworzeniem eksportu metryk.

cases.premise: Brakujące zużycie tokenów pozostaje jawną wartością nieznaną.
cases.hypothesis: Brakujące zużycie tokenów jest zapisywane jako zero.

cases.premise: Zbiór testowy jest rozdzielony według projektu i czasu obserwacji.

cases.premise: Zdalna analiza modelu czeka na świeżą jednorazową zgodę.
